yt_description:
Which Jeep Grand Cherokee ZJ year should you avoid? NHTSA's complaint database holds a similar 1,200 to 1,560 complaints for every ZJ model year, with 1998 logging the most powertrain reports, and CarComplaints.com shows no ZJ year standing out. SlashGear picks 1993, 1994 and 1998 and says to avoid 1995–96 for transmission complaints, but the complaint counts don't single one out. Buy on condition instead: frame rust, leaks, a transfer case that works in every mode, and the 13V-252 hitch recall done.

Every ZJ year, with the reasons and sources: https://boxytrucks.com/models/jeep/grand-cherokee-zj/years/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social

Photos: DarkSaturos90 (public domain); The Greater Southwestern Exploration Company, CC BY 2.0. Voiceover is AI-generated.
